habit_scope: alternate for long span / fewer interior bearings (AF&PA Truss-framed; HUD RSDG §§1.1, 5.4).
how_it_is_done: Sill/anchors on the cured wall, same platform-frame start as sawn/I-joist (AF&PA Sills). P05 complete before this floor.
Bearings and girders per the shop drawings. Fewer interior bearings is the reason this alt exists (AF&PA Truss-framed; HUD §§1.1, 5.4).
Set metal-plate floor trusses with the metal anchors the books name. 24-in o.c. module is the AF&PA truss-framed module. Do not treat this as sawn joists or as I-joists.
Strongbacks for vibration (HUD §5.3). That is the vibration note in this set — not a web-cut guide.
Rim / anchors as the shop drawings and AF&PA metal-anchor note. Draft-stop trussed floors is named in AF&PA (Fig 43; SFR draft-stop ≤500 sf) — process note, not a Method.

Subfloor: same panel family as platform floors (AF&PA Sub-flooring; HUD §5.4.4). Glue-nail is the stiffness/squeak recommendation in AF&PA/HUD; PJI glue-required rule is I-joist catalog spans, not this product.
Shop drawings on site (HUD §1.3, §5.4). Floor in before significant basement backfill (HUD §4.5).
No web-cut guide in this set (gap-floor-truss-web-cuts). Do not borrow sawn notch rules or I-joist Table 9 for truss webs.
trades: framing subcontractors (AF&PA names subcontractors / job foreman / inspector — no crew size)
tools_equipment: Not a tool list in sources. Named: metal anchors (AF&PA Truss-framed).
inspection_hold_points: Strongbacks per HUD §5.3 where vibration is the concern.
Do not field-cut webs without a guide — none in this set (gap-floor-truss-web-cuts).
Floor in before significant basement backfill (HUD §4.5).
when_this_beats_habit: Long span / fewer interior bearings / MEP chases through the truss volume (AF&PA Truss-framed; HUD §§1.1, 5.4). Not the volume habit.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: Using it as if it were sawn or I-joist (wrong hole rules). SOG South — no joist package. No web-cut improvisation — open gap.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: Volume jobs run I-joist or sawn. Floor truss is a plate-shop package; small markets may not stock it. Keep the method; labor_unavailable_small_market is a Constraint only if a market actually lacks the trade — not asserted here.
permit_gate: should be on drawings before permit
risk_if_swapped_late: Truss vs I-joist after permit changes bearings, layout, and MEP routing. Catch before permit.
plain_language_summary: Floor trusses when you want a long span and fewer posts. They come as a package with drawings. Put strongbacks on for bounce. Do not cut the webs using joist rules — this set has no web-cut guide. Not the everyday floor.
spanish_summary: Cerchas de piso cuando quiere claro largo y menos apoyos. Llegan como paquete con planos. Strongbacks contra el brinco. No corte almas con reglas de vigueta — aquí no hay guía de cortes. No es el piso de todos los días.
confidence_notes: Existence and long-span role sourced. No web-cut guide → med, not high. Strongbacks HUD §5.3 only.
open_gaps: Gap — book did not name a fail item
remodel_note: Remodel extras (matching, occupied-site, shoring) not in these four books — Gap, do not invent remodel-only methods.

fastener_schedule.pattern: through treated sill into wall (CIP/CMU, crawl wall, or slab stem/edge)
fastener_schedule.source: ORNL notes 13/31; AF&PA Sills. Embed D2 both variants (AF&PA ≥6 in CIP / ≥15 in block vs ORNL most codes ≥7 in / some 15 in masonry for uplift) — follow AHJ. Do not pick a winner.

fastener_schedule.size: not named in extract (grid only; no brand)
fastener_schedule.pattern: panels long way across supports, ≥2 spans

tools: metal anchors (AF&PA Truss-framed; size not in extract)

layering: Subfloor ~1/8 in gap (AF&PA Sub-flooring) — same panel family as platform floors.
Draft-stop trussed floors ≤500 sf (AF&PA Fig 43) — not a web-cut guide.
Strongbacks for vibration (HUD §5.3). No web-cut guide in this set (gap-floor-truss-web-cuts).
